brain_intelligence_guidelines.title: Client-Side Drag-and-Drop Ingestion with Immediate In-Memory Preview
brain_intelligence_guidelines.invariant: File transformation utilities that require server upload queues or complex multi-step wizards create friction and user drop-off. -> Digital utility products must provide a unified single-dropzone ingestion interface supporting drag-and-drop, clipboard paste, and file pick

p0_mvp_scope: Core domain logic and robust execution pipeline
Responsive, accessible user interface adhering to WCAG AA tokens
